annotations.title: Add a site or group to a status page

description: Use this when the user wants another of their sites, or a group heading, shown on one of their status pages. Returns what was added: a site with the checks chosen under it, placed in a group if one is named. A site already on the page gains only the checks it did not show, and a group that exists is not added twice. Not for creating a page: use plan_status_page.

children.description: Only these of the site's checks, by id or name.

description.description: Optional text visitors see under the name.

group.description: The group heading to put the site under, by name or id; created when the page has none of that name.

include_children.description: True to show every content check, dependency and cron job of the site under it.

name.description: The name visitors see; the site's name when left out. Required for a group.

site.description: The site to show, by id, name or part of its URL. Leave out to add a group heading named name.

status_page.description: The page's id, name or address.

name: add_status_page_component
title: Add a site or group to a status page
